title: Quiz
summary: QUIZ, noun An enigma; a riddle or obscure question. QUIZ, verb transitive To puzzle. [A popular, but not an elegant word.] Quo Warranto, in Law Latin, a writ brought before a proper tribunal, to inqui

inlines.v: QUIZ, noun An enigma; a riddle or obscure question. QUIZ, verb transitive To puzzle. [A popular, but not an elegant word.] Quo Warranto, in Law Latin, a writ brought before a proper tribunal, to inquire by what warrant a person or corporation exercises certain powers.
